programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Boban air bhioran an-diugh - oir tha prèasant còmhdaicht’ aige do dh’ Fhuigheag! Ach an dùil a bheil fios aig Fuigheag dè th’ ann am prèasant? Boban is excited today, as he has a wrapped present for Fuigheag! Does Fuigheag know what a present is though?

programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: An-diugh tha Pàdraig agus Heidi còmhla rithe ‘s iad a’ dèanamh coiridh ghlasrach. Ach mus tòisich iad, feumaidh iad a bhith cinnteach gu bheil an stuth a tha a dhìth orra a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach mar a thathar a’ fàs càl-colaig. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson a’ choiridh ullachadh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd ga ithe. Linda is joined by Patrick and Heidi to make vegetable curry. Before cooking, they have to ensure all the ingredients are present. If not, they make a list and go shopping for what's missing. They also learn more about how cauliflowers are grown, then return to the kitchen to make the curry before sitting down to tuck in.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Nìp ga lorg fhèin ann an suidheachadh steigeach às dèidh a bhith a’ feuchainn air cleasan siorcais. Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ cuideachadh Nìp ga ghlanadh fhèin, ach chan eil an seo ach toiseach nan trioblaidean aige. Neep gets himself into a sticky situation, copying tricks from the circus. Abney and Teal help him to get cleaned up, but that's only the start of his problems!

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Chan eil na luchagan beaga ro shona an-diugh – ach, gu fortanach, tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean gan dèanamh toilichte. The mouse babies aren’t very joyful today but fortunately, Daolag-bhreac and Seillean are making them happy.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them? Tha na h-ialtagan a tha a' neadachadh ann an sead' an t-Seanair gach bliadhn', air a dhol a dhìth. An tèid aig Dan is Gran air na creutairean oidhcheach seo a thàladh air ais nuair nach cluinnear 'ad?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Ruairidh Gray a’ leughadh An t-Òran dhan a h-uile Duine. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Lucy Morris agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Màiri NicCumhais. Ruairidh Gray reads An t-Òran dhan a h-uile Duine, written and illustrated by Lucy Morris and translated into Gaelic by Mairi MacCuish.

programme.title: Na Speuran
programme.desc: Thèid air turas suas dha na speuran cuide ris an Speuradair Bekah! Air an turas fànais iongantach seo tha i ag innse dhuinn mu Bhoireannaich ann am Fànas agus mun obair chudromach a tha iad air a dhèanamh. Bidh i cuideachd a’ toirt sùil air teothachd san fhànais. Blast off into space with Astronaut Bekah! In this amazing space voyage, she tells us about the valuable work of women in space. She also takes a look at temperature in the cosmos.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda, Mam is Twig a’ feuchainn rin slìghe a dhèanamh a-mach à coille neònach, far a bheil an t-uamhas fhrìdean is mòran chunnartan - is tha Flòraidh is Daibhidh cho làn iomagain air an son ‘s gu bheil ’ad a’ dol gan lorg. Hilda, her mum and Twig try to make their way out of a strange forest, full of trolls and much danger - while a worried David and Frida journey out of Trolberg to find them.

programme.title: Eilean Mo Ghaoil (From Lewis with Love)
programme.desc: Peigi Ann is busy with lambing, the west side football team are on home ground for an important game and Mairi and Tom take home the peats.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Tha Liam Alastair Crouse às Na Stàitean Aonaichte a’ tadhal air Joy san stiùidio agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a’ gabhail turas bàta gus lorg fhaighinn air eòin-mhara gu math sònraichte. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds. Joy Dunlop guides us through the next steps to speak Gaelic. Liam Alastair Crouse from the United States chats to Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean takes a boat trip to a colony of characterful seabirds. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Garradh Phadruig
programme.desc: Peter is busy planting in the garden and helps two budding gardeners with a pumpkin. Tha Pàdruig trang a’cur sa ghàrradh, agus a’cuideachadh dithis òga a’cur pheapaig.

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara/Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate travels around the North End of Skye, visiting a castle with strong connections to Clan MacLeod.

programme.title: Rudan Beaga Bòidheach/Life’s Little Things
programme.desc: Tha Niamh NicFhionghain a’ coinneachadh daoine òga eile gus na rudan beaga nar beatha a chomharrachadh. Niamh Mackinnon meets young people to celebrate life’s little things.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Tha Màiri Ross ag ionnsachadh mu eich dùthchasach na h-Alba. Mairi Ross learns about Scotland’s native horses.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Fàilte gu Fraochy Bay , baile nach fhaic thu a h-uile là! Is iomadh annas a tha ri fhaicinn sa bhaile , agus sin gun ghuth air càil ach muinntir a bhaile fhèin. Tha na tursachan a' tarraing luchd-turais air toir tuigse bho shàr - eòlaiche. Welcome to the colourful and unusual world of Fraochy Bay, a miniature metropolis somewhere off the map. An entrepreneurial spirit draws a group of novices to the local standing stones.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Iain MacKinnon reads excerpts from Gliocas bhon Bhìoball by Donald Saunders, and Mairi MacInnes narrates from The Mother’s Catechism.

programme.title: Andy Warhol's America
programme.desc: Charting Andy Warhol's response to the civil rights movement and the assassination of John F Kennedy, as well as other major historical events happening in America in the 1960s. We hear stories about Warhol setting up the Silver Factory and managing The Velvet Underground, and also how he faced his own personal nightmare: he was shot by a Factory associate.

programme.title: imagine...
programme.desc: Twenty-something virtuoso multi-instrumentalist, singer and arranger Jacob Collier has managed to outdo The Beatles by winning Grammy Awards for each of his first four albums. Alan Yentob meets Jacob and musicians he has collaborated with, including Stormzy, Chris Martin and film composer Hans Zimmer. He also talks to music legends Quincy Jones and Herbie Hancock, who believe Jacob Collier is one of the most talented musicians on the planet today.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Beginning at London Marylebone, the last great Victorian railway terminus to be built in the capital, Michael Portillo embarks on a postwar exploration of Britain’s southern counties. He travels to Denham in Buckinghamshire, where engineers are constructing a striking new viaduct, High Wycombe, a historic centre of furniture-making thanks to its abundant of beechwood forest, and Oxford, where he discovers the postwar origins of the charity shop. In the Wiltshire countryside, Michael meets the head of the Soil Association and some of her saddleback piglets to hear how the organic movement was founded after the Second World War in reaction to the intensification of farming.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take you so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. In the series final, cunning and tactics combine with logic, recall and tangential inspiration, as three committed Gamblers resist the temptation to take too many risks and the Strategists fight the impulse to err on the side of caution. Whose approach will win out in this battle of the giants? They'll compete to draw together the connections between elements which at first glance seem utterly random, from Captain Scarlet to Reg Cox to Marty Hopkirk to Arnold J Rimmer.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Sitcom about Hyacinth Bucket, an obsessive snob, and her embarrassing family. Hyacinth makes some very expensive holiday plans before dashing off to fulfil her voluntary church cleaning duties with the Ladies' Guild.

programme.title: One Foot in the Grave
programme.desc: Unexpected visitors drop in and mistakenly suspect Victor of killing an elderly blind man. A concert gives Victor the chance to use his ventriloquist's dummy.

programme.title: The Last Battle of the Vikings
programme.desc: Nowhere in the British Isles was the Viking connection longer-lasting or deeper than in Scotland. Hundreds of years after their first hit-and-run raids, the Norsemen still dominated huge swathes of the country. But storm clouds were gathering. In 1263 the Norwegian king Haakon IV assembled a fleet of 120 longships to counter Scottish raids on the Norse Hebrides. It was a force comparable in size to the Spanish Armada over three centuries later. But like the Armada, the Norse fleet was eventually defeated by a powerful storm. Driven ashore near present-day Largs, the beleaguered Norsemen were attacked by a Scottish army. The outcome of this vicious encounter would mark the beginning of the end of Norse power in Scotland. Marine archaeologist Dr Jon Henderson tells the incredible story of the Norsemen in Scotland. Visiting fascinating archaeological sites across Scotland and Norway, he reveals that, although the battle at Largs marked the end of an era for the Norsemen, their presence continued to shape the identity and culture of the Scottish nation to the present day.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: The British Army under General Cornwallis struggles to pacify the southern states. Meanwhile, one of the most respected American generals betrays the cause and defects to the British. Supported by the French Army and Navy, Washington’s Continental Army wins the decisive victory at Yorktown. Peace is restored, independence is won, and Americans aspire for a more perfect union. A film by Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt

programme.title: Easter Island Origins
programme.desc: They are some of the most famous and mysterious monuments on the planet. Nearly 900 giant stone heads scattered across a remote island in the middle of the Pacific. Now, brand new evidence is challenging everything we thought we knew about Easter Island’s awe-inspiring statues – and those who made them. Drawing on the latest science, this authoritative documentary radically rewrites the story of Easter Island.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: More from the day’s top stories and communities across Scotland.

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: In this episode, Ian and Major head to Angus and the town of Arbroath, a fine red sandstone town which nestles around its historic abbey. No longer with a fishing industry, the town relies on leisure boats visiting the beautiful little harbour, and Ian and Major have the chance to make pizza, bottle some rum and ride the dodgems.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: In Fife, Andy and Jo prepare to compete at one of the biggest highlights in the farming calendar, the Royal Highland Show. The event holds a special place in their hearts, as it's where they first met, but this year it's all about who can win the first rosette. In Caithness, it’s shearing time for Sally and champion shearer Helga. Long-time friends, the two women have competed together in New Zealand. Things are a lot trickier now with children in the mix as they wrestle sheep while trying to keep the kids amused. At Hillhead Farm, the first event of the season is imminent. The whole family pitches in to get the marquee up and the event site finished, and a decision has been made that will affect Ben’s future on the farm.

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
programme.desc: A cautionary tale about one of the UK’s most notorious credit card fraudsters, whose five-year crime wave began at just 16 years of age. While his contemporaries were using fake IDs to get into nightclubs, he was defrauding innocent cardholders from his desk in a call centre, laying the groundwork for a journey that would open up a world of wealth, first-class travel and an escape from the life he seemed destined for. But, as he soon discovers, this lifestyle would be laced with darkness, danger and terrible consequences.

programme.title: Growing Up Scottish
programme.desc: Some of Scotland's favourite comedians talk us through Scottish art, from finger painting to the Turner Prize via Mackintosh. They address the highs and lows of new town sculpture, how to appreciate a gallery, and what might be hidden away beyond the gift shop.

programme.title: The Troops
programme.desc: Under fire in Estonia, HQ falls and Shep takes command. Back home, there are goodbyes, scars, and one final performance to mark the end of duty and the start of something new.

programme.title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim
programme.desc: Paddleboarding to a hidden lagoon on Loch Trool, Jules and Greg spend the night in an ancient-style yurt beneath Galloway’s dark skies.

programme.title: The Scotts
programme.desc: Laura is loving life working in her cafe until one regular customer just happens to be the spitting image of her free pass - a Hollywood heartthrob. This is a game-changer. The extended family chip in with advice as Henry attempts to keep a lid on his jealousy. Meanwhile, Darren joins Colette on her mission to inspire all the pregnant women out there.

programme.desc: Laura is loving life working in her cafe until one regular customer just happens to be the spitting image of her free pass - a Hollywood heartthrob. This is a game-changer. The extended family chip in with advice as Henry attempts to keep a lid on his jealousy. Meanwhile, Darren joins Colette on her mission to inspire all the pregnant women out there.

programme.title: Disclosure Shorts
programme.desc: Ellis Horne loves Instagram but worries about its effect on her own body image. Ellis meets young people who feel their mental health has been negatively impacted by constant exposure to the perfect lives of others. She explores the role that influencers play in creating enviable lifestyles that are unobtainable to most, and asks the experts how to have a healthier relationship with the social media platform.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026

programme.title: Rooney
programme.desc: The 2022 documentary film giving unprecedented access to the life and career of one of football’s greatest strikers. Wayne Rooney recounts stories from some of the most important moments of his life, with testimonies from the people closest to him, including family, friends and his wife Coleen. From his time as a young boy growing up in the Liverpool district of Croxteth, through to his teenage life where his emerging stardom led to intense scrutiny from the British press, the film places Rooney’s professional career under a microscope, journeying through some of the highest and most challenging moments in the life of England’s record goal scorer. Footballing greats such as David Beckham, Gary Neville, Rio Ferdinand and Thierry Henry illustrate first-hand accounts of Rooney as a teammate and an opponent. Meaningful testimonies from the likes of Rooney’s first Premier League manager, David Moyes, and his first England manager, Sven-Göran Eriksson, describe the seemingly unlimited potential they saw in Rooney at such a young age.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Naturalist Steve Backshall's quest to meet 60 of the deadliest animals on the planet takes him to India. He is on the trail of the saw-scaled viper, said to be the deadliest snake on earth and responsible for 50,000 human deaths each year. It might seem that putting it on the Deadly 60 list is a formality but, in a country famous for enormous snakes, Steve discovers that it has plenty of competition. The sloth bear seems an unlikely candidate for the Deadly 60 until it becomes clear that it has razor sharp claws and an incredibly powerful jaw, attributes that do not go unnoticed by Steve as he gets a little too close to one of them. Steve puts his martial arts skills to good use as he tries praying mantis kung fu in an attempt to get to grips with an insect with one of the fastest strikes around.

Adam Henson explores high-tech strawberry farming, and John Craven launches Countryfile's annual photographic competition.

programme.title: Springwatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan celebrate the season’s standout wildlife moments as Springwatch heads towards its grand finale. Iolo Williams continues his exploration of the spectacular seabird colonies at Bempton Cliffs, where thousands of gannets, guillemots and puffins crowd the towering coastline.

programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A ballistics expert proves the shooting of a young woman was murder not manslaughter, and a forensic scientist secures justice for a cold case victim, 20 years after the crime.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Can you get the measure of Christina Trevanion's mystery object? It has a metal base that supports a measuring stick, with a moveable plastic pump attached. Will the fairgoers in Exeter guess what it is? While they puzzle its purpose, antiques experts Gary Pe and Ben Cooper hunt for bargains with dad and daughter David and Ellie and partners Darren and Simon. Darren immediately spots a stall of shiny costume jewellery. Gary thinks its inspiration comes from the Middle East but doubts any of it is profitable. On the other team, Ellie takes a fancy to a pair of etched, cut-glass decanters, but as Ben explains, they don’t make the sort of money they used to, so they stroll on. One of our pairs is also tempted by a massive nut with an exotic name – until they see the price tag! After the fair, Christina and the teams head to Wiltshire to see whether their items will bring in the cash at auction. Tim Weeks is on the rostrum, but who is going home with the most money?

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: In Nottinghamshire, police uncover shocking evidence of animal cruelty linked to a series of farmland poaching attacks. When officers raid a suspect’s property, they find disturbing scenes and uncover footage that leads to a painstaking investigation. With the help of estate managers, animal welfare investigators and neighbouring police forces, officers unite to bring animal cruelty offenders to justice. In Cumbria, a prized cow named Beauty becomes trapped at the bottom of a steep gorge after a walker leaves a farm gate open. According to her owner, Hunter Smith, the chances of survival look slim – until a daring rescue operation is launched, involving a local vet and the RAF. The team faces one of the most complex animal rescues ever attempted. And in Humberside, reporter Paul Colgan joins a rural crime officer using forensic DNA technology to mark valuable machinery – a simple but effective measure helping farmers protect their property and livelihoods.

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The freedivers and scuba team join forces to try to find a camera filled with precious memories at the bottom of Grasmere. Archive detective Sam is challenged to locate the family of a WWI Star medal found by local detectorists. Meanwhile, ceramicist Lucy, alongside six-year-old budding artist and granddaughter Blossom, turn finds fished from the lake into stunning works of art.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Twelve billion miles away, a tiny spaceship is leaving our solar system and entering the void of deep space. It is the first human-made object ever to do so. Slowly dying within its heart is a plutonium generator that will beat for perhaps another decade before the lights on Voyager finally go out. But this little craft will travel on for millions of years, carrying a golden record bearing recordings and images of life on Earth. The story of Voyager is an epic of human achievement, personal drama and almost miraculous success. Launched 16 days apart in 1977, the twin Voyager space probes have defied all the odds, survived countless near misses and almost 40 years later continue to beam revolutionary information across unimaginable distances. With less computing power than a modern hearing aid, they have unlocked the stunning secrets of our solar system. This film tells the story of these magnificent machines, the men and women who built them and the vision that propelled them farther than anyone could ever have hoped.

On the other team, Ellie takes a fancy to a pair of etched, cut-glass decanters, but as Ben explains, they don’t make the sort of money they used to, so they stroll on. One of our pairs is also tempted by a massive nut with an exotic name – until they see the price tag! After the fair, Christina and the teams head to Wiltshire to see whether their items will bring in the cash at auction. Tim Weeks is on the rostrum, but who is going home with the most money?

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: In Nottinghamshire, police uncover shocking evidence of animal cruelty linked to a series of farmland poaching attacks. When officers raid a suspect’s property, they find disturbing scenes and uncover footage that leads to a painstaking investigation. With the help of estate managers, animal welfare investigators and neighbouring police forces, officers unite to bring animal cruelty offenders to justice. In Cumbria, a prized cow named Beauty becomes trapped at the bottom of a steep gorge after a walker leaves a farm gate open. According to her owner, Hunter Smith, the chances of survival look slim – until a daring rescue operation is launched, involving a local vet and the RAF. The team faces one of the most complex animal rescues ever attempted. And in Humberside, reporter Paul Colgan joins a rural crime officer using forensic DNA technology to mark valuable machinery – a simple but effective measure helping farmers protect their property and livelihoods.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Twelve billion miles away, a tiny spaceship is leaving our solar system and entering the void of deep space. It is the first human-made object ever to do so. Slowly dying within its heart is a plutonium generator that will beat for perhaps another decade before the lights on Voyager finally go out. But this little craft will travel on for millions of years, carrying a golden record bearing recordings and images of life on Earth. The story of Voyager is an epic of human achievement, personal drama and almost miraculous success. Launched 16 days apart in 1977, the twin Voyager space probes have defied all the odds, survived countless near misses and almost 40 years later continue to beam revolutionary information across unimaginable distances. With less computing power than a modern hearing aid, they have unlocked the stunning secrets of our solar system. This film tells the story of these magnificent machines, the men and women who built them and the vision that propelled them farther than anyone could ever have hoped.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley mark the 50th anniversary of the Viking Way, exploring the people, wildlife and history connected by Lincolnshire's famous long-distance footpath. They uncover evidence of Viking settlers, meet the volunteers who maintain the route, visit the Ramblers' Church and witness efforts to protect water voles. Adam Henson explores high-tech strawberry farming, and John Craven launches Countryfile's annual photographic competition.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about Stan Smith, who works for the CIA. Stan is officially declared dead, but comes back to life to excavate his home in search of Oliver North's buried treasure.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. Louise chooses to research Amelia Earhart for a multimedia project on a personal hero but finds herself grappling with what Amelia's final failed flight means for her report, for young women and for herself - meanwhile, Linda finds herself gifted with a surprise Mother's Day gift but finds a deeper gift in helping Louise with her project.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. The Belcher kids put together a costumed wrestling act for the Crustacean Nation Wrestling Federation and recruit Teddy to join them as their on-stage nemesis, but wrestling the children turns out to be more difficult than Teddy bargained for.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. Marcus hopes that the Roman festival of Saturnalia will provide the perfect backdrop for him to finally woo Cynthia, and Grumio makes it his mission to salvage as much sacrificial meat from the city-wide celebrations as possible.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: To complete their dream home, hosts Brian McCourt and Sarah Keenleyside transform their underutilised backyard into a dream cottage retreat.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: It's Craig's turn to take on the Banker as Stephen Mulhern hosts the iconic game show with only one question. [S,AD]

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: In London, dancer Kea hopes to be impressed by the choices of three single lads. Will any of them shine?

programme.title: Georgia & Tommy: Baby Steps
programme.desc: The beginning of the fourth series of the reality programme following Tommy and Georgia - TOWIE'S favourite couple - on their journey in parenthood and all the joy, tears, stress and magical moments that go with it. In this episode, the pair are excited to share the news of their second pregnancy with their family, but they encounter problems early on in the pregnancy that results in heartbreaking news.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Amy's attempt to mediate between her cousin Harry and new pal Bobby ended in a row at the curry house that got more heated than her vindaloo - now Bobby's not just got beef with Harry, but Amy too. Bobby thinks that she should have had stuck up for him when Harry denied cheating - can Amy salvage the friendship, or will she back away from Bob out of loyalty to her cousin? Amy's not the only mate stuck in the middle - Courtney and Chloe M are on good terms with Clelia, but there is no love lost between her and their besties Chloe B and Amber. Can they persuade both parties that it's time to let bygones be bygones? Elsewhere, Ella's had a busy few weeks - not only did she drop the bombshell that she'd snogged Pete, but she also fell out with best mate Kelsey, who took her to task for kissing a guy she liked. The Pete situation seems to be in hand, with them agreeing to be nothing more than flirty friends... but she and Kelsey haven't spoken since their argument, and Ella is gutted.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. There is trouble in paradise as the ladies embark on their trip to Puerto Vallarta - while Angie feels slighted after Meredith's bat mitzvah, Bronwyn and Lisa have a falling-out over room assignments and Mary chooses to stay in Salt Lake City as issues with Robert Jr come to a head. Elsewhere, Britani makes a new announcement as Bronwyn comes to terms with Gwen's decision about her grandparents.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. Tamra and Jenn try to find common ground between their men, Gina reflects on her ex-husband's new engagement, Shannon is rocked by a bombshell article about the lawsuit, Heather accompanies Terry to get rhinoplasty, and Katie hosts a couples' dinner party where Ryan finds himself in the hot seat with Tamra.

programme.title: Dinner Date
programme.desc: Anja-Katharina from Bristol is going to be given five menus, each put together by a potential blind date. The five men behind the menus have all come up with a three course meal but Anja-Katharina will only be having dinner with three of them. She will choose her dates based on the menus she most likes the look of. But when the dinners have been eaten and the dates are done, who will she want to see for seconds?

programme.title: Supermarket Sweep
programme.desc: Rylan Clark-Neal hosts a revamp of the iconic game show where three pairs of shoppers go wild in the aisles as they compete in the ultimate supermarket challenge to win a 3,000-pound prize - along with the classic Supermarket Sweep quizzes, trolley dashes and pastel jumpers, the revamped show features exciting new games, challenges and some famous faces.

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the American version of the dramatic and fast-paced game show. The final 16 players enter the home stretch.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Demi has found love with new girlfriend Francesca - in classic Demi style, things are moving fast. It's two months in and Francesca has moved countries so they can shack up together in London - Frankie has already warned her little sister against rushing things, but Demi has naturally ignored every word... how will Francesca fare as she tries to infiltrate the Sims clan, and will Demi manage to convince her sisters that this time it's forever? Meanwhile, Frankie hasn't seen Ella since her awkward admission that she fancies Pete - since then, the plot has thickened further with the revelation that the two of them have locked lips. Will Frankie reconsider her friendship with Ella out of loyalty to her sister, and will Frankie warn Ella to think twice before getting involved with her sister's ex when the girls come together? Elsewhere, Gatsby and Dani are going strong after a string of successful dates, and Gatsby is ready to step things up by introducing her to best mates Dan and Diags.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The Mexico trip continues as the ladies set sail on a yacht excursion, Lisa updates the group on life with John and Henry, and Britani takes offence at the lack of enthusiasm over her latest announcement - meanwhile, Bronwyn reveals some dark truths about her marriage and is surprised by Heather's grace and Lisa's lack of support. After Mary arrives at the trip, the ladies come together for a beautiful VIDA dinner where Meredith learns that her late-night antics have fuelled Britani with fresh gossip and Angie and Bronwyn confront Lisa for a dramatic conclusion to the evening.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. Tamra reveals more surprising information about Ryan that leaves Jenn to question her friendship with Tamra once again, Emily and Heather discuss body image, and Shannon hosts a tea party to reveal that she's taking almost everyone on a trip to London to celebrate her 60th birthday - however, Alexis learns that her olive branch to Shannon didn't work out the way she intended and is cordially not invited.

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Nikki Fox, Robert Rinder, and Georgia Taylor all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the American version of the dramatic and fast-paced game show. Test your game show hosts, Shakespeare, and sneakers knowledge.
